summary: Ireena's letters (Story Allies Presence Plan, package I3). While she shelters (the Blue Water Inn, St. Andral's, the Krezkovs' house, or her father's mansion after the party declined to take her) and the party is somewhere else, a courier finds the party outdoors with a letter in her hand after the big things she would hear of: the festival's end, the Abbot's bats over Krezk's wall, the werewolf den's end, the winery's wine, the beacon at Argynvostholt, the dinner at the castle. One visit, up to six times and at least two days apart; which letter plays is read from the flags in narrative/allies/ireena_letters:letter. Each letter adds one to ireena_letters_unanswered and any check-in (narrative/allies/ireena:checkin) sets it back to 0. Letters stop at three unanswered; at three Strahd writes to the party about her (the second visit, once, and her trust falls by one). Words only; the party answers them by visiting. Lines: narrative/allies/ireena_letters.dialogue; the design: docs/story/ireena_letters.md.

visits.summary: A courier brings the party a letter from Ireena outdoors, while she shelters elsewhere, after something she would hear of. At most six, at least 48 hours apart, and none while three letters sit unanswered.
